shape.situation_pattern: The system must never become a cult even while holding sovereign power over its own operation.
shape.decision: Govern by Ostrom + mycelial plurality with no new throne; instrument is a local clerk/router, not R0-complete without evidence.
shape.reasoning_physics: Tool for the vigilant, not a throne for the will. Evidence, not worship, is the authority; a local clerk that over-claims becomes the windmill it exists to refuse.
